jobs.employer: The Law Society of New South Wales
jobs.notes: Applications open 9:00am AEST Wednesday 9 June 2027; the Society publishes two alternative closing dates (Sunday 4 July and Sunday 11 July 2027, 11:59pm AEST) that vary by participating firm, so a single confirmed close date cannot be stated — offers can be made from 9:00am Wednesday 8 September 2027 and eligibility is generally penultimate-year students.

jobs.program: Seasonal Clerkship and Graduate Recruitment — 2027 program cycle
jobs.notes: The QLS page confirms a 2027 program cycle exists with clerkship recruitment commencing in July/August and programs running across Summer One, Summer Two, Autumn and Winter, but the exact application open/close dates in the published key-dates table could not be read from the source, so no dates are asserted.
